verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਧੋਏ ਬਿਨ ਅੰਬਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਨ ਤੇਲ ਮੇਲੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੇਸ ਹੂੰ ਭਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal dhoe bin a(n)bar maleen hot bin tel mele taise kes hoo(n) bhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a cloth not washed with water remains dirty; and the hair remains disheveled and entangled without application of oil;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bin maa(n)je dharapan jot heen hot barakhaa bihoon jaise khet mai na dhaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a glass not cleaned cannot let the light come through and just as no crop grows in a field without rain,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਭਵਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਲੋਣ ਘ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bin dheepak bhavan a(n)dhakaar hot lon ghirat bin jaise bhojan samaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a house remains in darkness without a lamp and just as food tastes insipid without salt and ghee,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ੍ਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise bin saadh sa(n)git janam maran dhukh miTat na bhram bin gur giaan hai ||537||

en.bdb: Similarly without the company of saintly souls and devotees of the True Guru, the distress of repeated births and death cannot be wiped out. Nor can worldly fears and suspicions be destroyed without practicing on the sermon of the True Guru.  (537)
